title: Bagalkot sugarcane farmers continue protest seeking higher prices

ai.summary: Sugarcane farmers in Bagalkot district continued protesting for higher prices, demanding ₹5,500 per tonne and profit-sharing arrangements.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers continued their protest in Bagalkot district on Thursday seeking higher prices for their produce.
facts.quote: Sugarcane farmers continued their protest in Bagalkot district on Thursday seeking higher prices for their produce.

facts.claim: The protestors are demanding ₹5,500 per tonne of sugarcane in the district.
facts.quote: The protestors are demanding ₹5,500 per tonne of sugarcane in the district.

facts.claim: They took out a rally in Bagalkot and vowed not to allow crushing operations in the district till the sugar factories promised higher prices.
facts.quote: They took out a rally in Bagalkot and vowed not to allow crushing operations in the district till the sugar factories promised higher prices.

facts.claim: The farmers are demanding implementation of the C. Rangarajan committee recommendations that ask sugar factories to treat growers as shareholders and not as raw material suppliers.
facts.quote: The farmers are demanding implementation of the C. Rangarajan committee recommendations that ask sugar factories to treat growers as shareholders and not as raw material suppliers.

facts.claim: They also want the State government to ensure that farmers get at least 50% profit out of cultivation, after considering all costs.
facts.quote: They also want the State government to ensure that farmers get at least 50% profit out of cultivation, after considering all costs.

facts.claim: In Haveri, Deputy Commissioner Vijay Mahantesh Danammanavar and Superintendent of Police Yashodha Vantagudi held a meeting with farmers leaders and factory owners.
facts.quote: In Haveri, Deputy Commissioner Vijay Mahantesh Danammanavar and Superintendent of Police Yashodha Vantagudi held a meeting with farmers leaders and factory owners.

facts.claim: Farmers in Haveri are demanding ₹3,800 per tonne and a profit-sharing formula on the Belagavi model.
facts.quote: Farmers in Haveri are demanding ₹3,800 per tonne and a profit-sharing formula on the Belagavi model.

ai.background_note: Karnataka sugarcane farmers have been protesting since 2025 over lower prices and profit-sharing, with the state offering ₹3,300 per tonne.
